sentences.en: The linear regression showed that race was tied to mental health outcomes.
sentences.zh: 线性回归分析显示，种族与心理健康结果有关联。

sentences.en: Support vector machines are supervised learning models used for classification and regression analysis.
sentences.zh: 支持向量机是一种用于分类和回归分析的监督学习模型。

sentences.en: It is not progress but regression.

senses.zh: 衰退,（尤指因催眠或精神疾患，或为逃避目前忧虑）回到从前,回归,（统计学） 回归
